summary: Stop idle data-parallel ranks' dummy draft steps from writing KV through stale block tables
compatibility: Affects speculative decoding with data parallelism (DP > 1) on the model-runner v2 path; no user action required.
details: A dummy draft decode step on an idle DP rank could write KV through block-table rows left by finished requests, corrupting cache pages another request reuses.
Padded rows now map to the pad slot. Backport of vllm-project/vllm#56734 with the original author.
